newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish KPW clears Lentex carpet maker public offer.
newsitem.headline: Polish KPW clears Lentex carpet maker public offer.

text.p: The Polish Securities Commission (KPW) cleared a 1.5-million-share initial public offering and 4.5 million existing shares of carpet maker Lentex SA, the KPW Chairman Jacek Socha told a news conference on Thursday.
Lentex president Franciszek Koszarek, also present, said the new shares would be offered in separate tranches for large investors, retail investors and employees.
Koszarek said the company, which would seek listing on the Warsaw bourse's main market, would use proceeds from the issue to buy machinery, build a warehouse and expand its distribution network.
Koszarek said the issue price for the subscription starting on January 28 would be set through book building.
Lentex is 33-percent owned by the National Investment Fund No 1 and 25-percent owned by the state treasury.
Lentex earned net 11.2 million zlotys on sales of 150.2 million zlotys in 1995.
